notes: Ethereum mainnet (chain ID 1). One application; existing ZTO with 18 decimals. Sixteen static constructor arguments: coin, admin, adam, seatRoot, startTime, caveLength, roundLength, firstPrice, floorPrice, then seven right-zero-padded ASCII bytes32 labels in cave order. Dead is the fixed constant 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD. Nonpayable constructor makes no external calls and mints 0 to Adam and 736 to admin. No initialization or funding. Payments go directly from buyers to dead. No owner, pause, upgrade or recovery. Chain selection belongs to the deployment service; this repository does not broadcast.
